subject: New version of Rtools does not update GCC as of yet

messages.author: 20758fda448fdbda
messages.subject: New version of Rtools does not update GCC as of yet
parts:
I know this belongs on Stan-developers, but I do not have post access there. Please see the thread on r-devel starting here: <https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-devel/2015-January/070355.html>. GCC will remain at 4.6.3 prerelease. Personal experience shows that the current script has problems in GCC 4.8.x, but these /may/ be able to be cirumvented. There are significant issues with 4.9.x, as the "fixes" used to get R to build on windows are optimized away, and old bugs resurface.

Avi
